question: Who were the experiments actually run on?
answer: Overwhelmingly, undergraduates in rich Western universities — a group later shown to be among the least typical humans on measures from fairness to visual illusions. A field describing "human nature" had been sampling the most unusual population available, because it was the one down the corridor.
move: The default human in psychology was a Western undergraduate.
source: Henrich, Heine & Norenzayan, Behavioral and Brain Sciences, 2010
